snippet.title: Tiberium Dusk Colonel Havoc Demo
snippet.description:
Introducing the absolute unit that is Nick Parker, aka Colonel Havoc to Tiberium Dusk. Armed with a Personal Ion Cannon and Ion Cannon beacons, this hero / commando unit is a force to be reckoned with. 
Mod: https://www.moddb.com/mods/tiberium-dusk
